Select distinct compound ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against the human CB2 receptor in human assays. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then to assays, then to target_dictionary, filtering for target name Cannabinoid CB2 receptor and assay organism Homo sapiens. Join compound_structures as an inner join to require structures. Return compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id ascending.
